verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Pipedream MCP servers load all available tools automatically into the client's context (docs-4: 'Automatically loads all available tools') and organizes by per-app dedicated servers, not by an agent-facing meta-tool search/load pattern. No mention of a 'search_tools' or 'load_tool_by_name' meta-tool mechanism that would let an agent avoid stuffing thousands of definitions into context.
